name: M38 #0007 – Goldbach Conjecture
description:
Part of the ultra-limited M38 'Unsolved Math Problems' series. Only 10 holographic luxury cards exist. Each represents one of the greatest unsolved mysteries in mathematics. Owning one means owning a piece of human curiosity itself.

Every even number greater than 2 is the sum of two primes. One of the oldest unsolved problems.
